Name: Captain Flip

log.board.pass-map-right: <who>{player}</who> passes the Treasure Map<map></map> to the <right></right>
header.draw.you: You draw a Character tile from the bag
header.draw.player: {player} draws a Character tile from the bag
header.flip.player: {player} must place the Character or flip it
header.monkey.you: Flip a Character adjacent to your Monkey
header.monkey.player: {player} must flip a Character adjacent to the Monkey
header.coins.gain.you: {effect}: you take {coins, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}
header.coins.gain.player: {effect}: {player} takes {coins, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}
header.coins.lose.you: {effect}: you lose {coins, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}
header.coins.lose.player: {effect}: {player} loses {coins, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}
pick-map.title: Choose a Treasure Map
pick-map.subtitle: Pick the map you want to take.
header.pass-map.you: Choose a direction to pass the Treasure Maps: <left>← Left</left> or <right>Right →</right>
header.pass-map.player: {player} must choose a direction to pass the Treasure Maps
header.play-cell.you: Choose a tile from one of your Cell spaces to play
header.play-cell.player: {player} must choose a tile from a Cell space
header.flip-cell.you: Flip one of your Cell tiles
treasure-map.effect: If you have the Treasure Map at the end of your turn, take 1 coin.
cartographer.effect: Take the Treasure Map and place it near your board.
cartographer.quote: “Oops, I was holding it upside down!”
navigator.effect: Take 2 coins per Cartographer on your board.
parrot.effect: Draw and play a new tile.
cook.effect: Take 1 coin per Character in their row, including the Cook themself.
swabby.effect.end-game: Take [1/4/9/16/25] coins if you have at least 1 Swabby in [1/2/3/4/5] columns.
gunner.effect.end-game: If you have 3 or more Gunners on your board, you lose the game.
carpenter.effect.end-game: Take 3 coins if there is no Gunner in their row or column.
monkey.effect: Take 1 coin then flip one adjacent tile. Apply the effects of the revealed Character.
lookout.effect.end-game: Take 4 coins if there is no Character above this tile, in this column.
tile.characters:
Each tile features a different Character on either side.
There are 9 unique Characters, each appearing 16 times across the tiles.
bag.count: There are {number, plural, one{# tile} other{# tiles}} left in the bag.
board.help: Choose which adventure board all players will use for this game. Each board offers a different layout of spaces and effects.
board.kraken-bonus: In the jaws of the Kraken
board.observatory.help: Features TWO Treasure Maps: the one you chose, plus a second one drawn at random at the start of the game.
board.bonus: When you place a character on the highest square of a column, apply any immediate bonus.
end-game.rule: When someone completes four columns on their board, finish the round.
end-game.flag.you: This flag identifies that you have started the game.
end-game.flag.player: This flag is used to identify that {firstPlayer} has started the game.
end-game.last.you: You'll play the last round at the end of the game.
end-game.last.player: {player} will therefore play the last turn at the end of the game.
effect.take-coins: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
effect.not-first:
The first player who places a Character on this space does not take any coins.
<0>All subsequent players</0> who place a Character on this space take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
effect.race:
The first player who places a Character on this space takes {first, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
<0>All subsequent players</0> who place a Character on this space take {then, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
effect.same-all: At the end of the game, take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} if all Characters in this column are IDENTICAL.
effect.diff-all: At the end of the game, take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} if all Characters in this column are DIFFERENT.
effect.column-full: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} for each completed column on your Board, including this one.
effect.diff-each: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} for each different Character in this column.
effect.pay: To place a Character on this space, you must pay 1 coin. If you have no coins, you cannot place a Character here.
effect.flip.diff: If the characters in this column are ALL different, you must return the character tile from your board.
effect.replay.same: If the characters in this column are ALL identical, you draw a new tile.
effect.treasure.same: If the characters in this column are ALL identical, you take the Treasure Map.
effect.replay.diff: Draw and play a new tile if all Characters in this column are ALL different.
effect.diff-adjacent: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} for each different Character on the adjacent spaces (not including the placed Character).
effect.row-same: When you complete this row, take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} if all Characters are IDENTICAL.
effect.row-first-then: The first player to complete this row takes {first, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}. All subsequent players take {then, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
effect.coins-and-map: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} and the Treasure Map.
effect.coins-per-map: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} per Treasure Map you own.
effect.pass-map: Choose left or right. Each player who owns a Treasure Map passes it to their neighbor in that direction.
effect.first-flip-then: The first player who places a tile on this space flips a Character on their board and applies its effect. All subsequent players take {then, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
effect.play-from-cell: Choose a tile from one of your Cell spaces and play it WITHOUT flipping it. Apply the Character's effects.
effect.flip-cell: Flip one of your Cell tiles. Do NOT apply the revealed Character's effect.
effect.coins-per-bomb: Take {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}} for each visible Bomb symbol in your play area.
effect.steal-left: Steal 1 coin from the player to your left for each Character on their board identical to the one you just placed.
effect.steal-right: Steal 1 coin from the player to your right for each Character on their board identical to the one you just placed.
effect.sextant: While this space is not covered, it counts as an extra Cartographer for the Navigator.
effect.bomb: While this space is not covered, it counts as a Bomb (Gunner) for scoring purposes.
effect.bomb-when-filled: Once this Treasure Map space is covered, it also counts as a Bomb (Gunner) for scoring purposes.
treasure-map.cursed.effect: You CANNOT flip any tiles. Take 2 coins at the end of your turn.
treasure-map.inflamed.effect: You have a Bomb. It counts for the Gunner effect and end-of-game. Take 1 coin at the end of your turn. End of game: take 5 coins.
treasure-map.gambler.effect: If you gained no coins during this turn, take 2 coins.
treasure-map.kraken.effect: At the end of your turn, steal 1 coin from the richest player. If you are strictly the richest, steal nothing.
treasure-map.alldirections.effect: When you take this card, place it with North facing up. At the end of each turn, take the indicated coins (1, 2, 1, then 3) and rotate the card a quarter turn clockwise.
treasure-map.option.help: Choose which Treasure Map variant will be used during the game. The Base Map is free; other variants are subscriber only and bring unique twists. On the Observatory board, a second random Treasure Map is added on top of your choice.
coins.player: {player} owns {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
coins.you: You have {number, plural, one{# coin} other{# coins}}.
coins.victory: The player with the most coins wins the game.
tuto.welcome: Welcome to the <0>Captain Flip</0> tutorial, captain!
tuto.goal: In Captain Flip, you recruit a crew to sail and collect gold.
tuto.coins: You win if you have the most Coins at the end of the game!
tuto.draw: It's your turn. At the start of your turn, you automatically draw a character tile from the bag.
tuto.gunner: You've drawn a Gunner! Place it in your boat.
tuto.gunner.effect: The Gunner immediately earns you 5 Coins, but beware: if you have 3 or more Gunner in your boat at the end of the game, you've lost!
tuto.popup: At any time, you can click on a character to see its effect.
tuto.opponent: Now it's your opponent's turn: he'll draw a character, place him in his boat and apply his effect.
tuto.you: Now it's your turn. You will draw a character tile.
tuto.lookout: A lookout! It yields 4 Coins at the end of the game if there is no other character above it.
tuto.flip:
When you don't like a Character, you can choose to flip it <1>(i.e. turn the tile over to its other side)</1>.
Each Character tile has 2 different characters on the front and back.
tuto.lookout.flip: Flip the Lookout to discover the other character.
tuto.cartographer:
It's a Cartographer. Place it in your boat.
<1>Beware, if you choose to flip the tile, you have to keep this new Character!</1>
tuto.cartographer.effect:
The Cartographer allows you to claim the <0>Treasure Map</0>.
As long as you have it, you earn 1 Coin at the end of your turn!
tuto.swabby:
It's a Swabby.
Characters have 2 kinds of effect: immediate effects (yellow background), and end-of-game effects (gray background).
Click on the Mousse to see its end-of-game effect.
Then place it in your boat.
tuto.column.completed: When you complete a column, you earn its eventual bonus! Here, you immediately earn 3 Coins.
tuto.trigger-end: The game continues in this way until one player has completed 4 columns of his ship: the round is then completed, the end-of-game effects are applied (grey background), and the richest player wins!
tuto.go: It's up to you now. Godspeed, Captain!
